verdict.rationale: Factory provides a CLI quickstart for installing Droid and delegating tasks, plus integrations (Linear, Jira, MCP) for triggering work, but there is no evidence of a one-click GitHub/GitLab App-style repo installation flow like a native repo connector; installation still requires CLI setup and separate registering of machines (BYOM). Missing for 10: explicit one-click repo/App install flow, evidence of zero-config repo authorization, independent confirmation of ease-of-setup.
